name: MNHLDG
recent: MN Holdings 近期获得价值 RM12 亿的太阳能 EPCC 合约，并有一系列凭单转换活动。同时，董事和主要股东在闭市期内外有买卖交易。
notable: 获得价值 RM12 亿的太阳能 EPCC 合约，位于 Terengganu。
获得数据中心基础设施合约，价值 RM2.9388 亿。
凭单转换导致新股上市，发行价每股 RM0.20。
risks: 一名独立非执行董事在闭市期内以每股 RM3.58 的价格出售了 200,000 股。
美国宣布新的芯片出口管制后，数据中心相关股票下跌。
earnings: 2026 财年（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM2.1147 亿，净利润为 RM2398 万，净利率 11.3%。营收环比增长 5.7%，同比增长 17.9%；净利润环比增长 12.1%，同比增长 98.8%。

recent_en: MN Holdings recently secured a RM1.2 billion solar EPCC contract and has had a series of warrant conversions. Meanwhile, directors and substantial shareholders have been trading both during and outside closed periods.
notable_en: Secured a RM1.2 billion solar EPCC contract in Terengganu.
Secured data centre infrastructure contracts worth RM293.88 million.
Warrant conversions resulted in the listing of new shares at RM0.20 per share.
risks_en: An independent non-executive director disposed of 200,000 shares at RM3.58 per share during the closed period.
Data centre-linked stocks fell after the US announced new chip export controls.
earnings_en: For FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM211.47 million and net profit was RM23.98 million, with a net margin of 11.3%. Revenue grew 5.7% QoQ and 17.9% YoY; net profit grew 12.1% QoQ and 98.8% YoY.
